description: Awen 1.0.4 - YouTube Music Speed Dial, Hybrid Recommendation Algorithm & Queue Continuity Fix

changelog.title: YouTube Music Speed Dial
items: Introduced full YouTube Music-style 3x3 Speed Dial grid on the Home screen.
Horizontal paging supporting up to 27 tracks, albums, artists, and playlists across 3 pages with animated page indicators.
Permanent pinning support: Pinned items stay anchored at the top of the Speed Dial with distinctive push-pin badges.
One-tap immediate playback: Start listening to any track directly from the dial without friction.
Automatic intelligent filling: Unpinned spots are dynamically populated by your listening history and personalized recommendations.

changelog.title: Hybrid Recommendation Intelligence
items: Optimized previous local algorithm: Advanced affinity scoring leveraging play counts, completion rate, recency decay, and forgotten favorites.
New adaptive algorithm: Real-time dayparting awareness (Morning Uplift, Afternoon Energy, Evening Unwind, Nocturnal Flow) combined with multi-seed YouTube collaborative discovery.
Harmonious 50/50 hybrid mixer: Seamlessly interleaves beloved favorites with fresh sonic discoveries while enforcing artist diversity limits.

changelog.title: Queue Continuity & Bug Fixes
items: Fixed empty queue on Recently Played: Playing any track from Recently Played now automatically queues all subsequent tracks with seamless radio continuation.
Smooth active playing states and equalizer indicators on Speed Dial tiles.
Enhanced in-app update stability and MIT License alignment.
